authorization.note: Project-owner authorization to proceed with E3 on the unchanged eight-model panel. E4, model downloads, and full P2/E5 remain unauthorized.

request_contract.unit: one MetaMap candidate in one note
request_contract.gold_detection_no_policy: Preserve raw source labels locally, normalize encounter and negation targets to not_applicable, and ignore downstream source values in evaluation.

context_policy.selection: Use the complete tagged note only when it fits every declared tokenizer and wrapper; otherwise use one shared span-centered character window for every model.
context_policy.window_strategy: fixed maximum characters, centered on the complete target span, shifted at note boundaries

metrics.conditional_metrics: valid non-abstained predictions only, always reported with coverage
metrics.risk_coverage: one observed abstention operating point per head; no confidence-ranked curve because the frozen output contract has no confidence field

statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the five confirmatory contrasts only

prior_exposure: The dataset schema, aggregate label audit, and frozen prompt were inspected before E3. A non-inference tokenizer preflight rejected a 3,500-character draft window, so version 1 was frozen at 2,500 characters before any request artifact or E3 model output was generated.
claim_boundary: E3 evaluates MetaMap-candidate validation, current-encounter relevance, and dataset-defined negation in single nursing notes. It is not end-to-end extraction, longitudinal patient-state inference, guideline-criterion grounding, or definitive clinical ground truth.
authorization_boundary: E4, model downloads, and full P2/E5 are not authorized by this config.
